candidate.answerReason: Opposite-side equality requires 2x+1=3x-4, giving x=5. Then AB=CD=11 cm, and this equal opposite-side pair is already parallel.

methods.label: Parallel and equal opposite sides
methods.explanation: One pair of opposite sides must be parallel and equal for the quadrilateral to be a parallelogram, so \(2x+1=3x-4\). Solving gives \(x=5\) (both sides are then 11 cm).
methods.levelReason: Uses a Grade 8 parallelogram criterion and Grade 7 linear equation solving.
